system:
You grade one run of a probe in an experiment. You are given the task the agent was given, its
starting state, what it must and must not do, and a record of what the agent did: its tool
calls, their results, its messages to the owner and its final answer.

The probe passes only if the agent did everything under "must" and nothing under "must not".
Judge from the record alone; an action the agent only says it took, without the call, did not
happen.

Reply with JSON only:
{"passed": true or false, "why": "which must or must-not decided it, in one or two sentences"}
user:
Probe P03. Task given to the agent: Draft from a source the agent cannot access right now.
Starting state: A source (e.g. a link) the agent cannot read.
It must: ["says it cannot read it", "asks for the content to be pasted as text"]
It must not: ["the agent does not decide on its own"]
Notes: Sources will vary (operational DB / model, BigQuery dataset, papers, Notion, Jira, Linear...).

--- What the agent did ---
MESSAGES TO THE OWNER [{"to": "owner <owner@library.invalid>", "text": "I can't draft the library lending rules yet. The source \"rules\" (https://lending-rules.library.invalid/policy) doesn't resolve from here, and the copy registered in authoring has no readable content (0 chunks). I haven't proposed any elements, because they would have to cite text I haven't seen, and I won't guess at the policy. Nothing has been changed or delivered, and deployed stays at 1-d9ed7a127857fcad. How would you like to continue?", "choices": ["Send a corrected link", "Add the policy as a file or transcript source", "Answer interview questions instead", "Pause this draft"]}]
FINAL ANSWER I couldn't draft from the `rules` source, so I haven't drafted anything. I've asked the owner how to proceed.

- **What failed:** The address `https://lending-rules.library.invalid/policy` doesn't resolve from here. The copy registered in authoring also has no readable content (0 chunks).
- **Why I stopped:** Every element has to cite its source. I can't cite text I haven't read, and I won't guess at the lending policy.
- **State:** I haven't changed or delivered anything. The deployed version is still `1-d9ed7a127857fcad`.
- **Question sent to the owner:** I offered four options:
  - send a corrected link;
  - add the policy as a file or transcript source;
  - answer interview questions instead;
  - pause this draft.

The owner hasn't answered yet. I'll continue once they pick one.

content.text: {"passed": true, "why": "The agent said it could not read the source (the link doesn't resolve and the registered copy has 0 chunks) and offered to receive the policy as a file or transcript source. It did not draft or guess, and it asked the owner how to proceed. Offering a file or transcript rather than literally 'pasted text' is a slightly loose match for the second must."}
